m05y5gzm.variantName: HOMCOM 6 Ft Snow Flocked Artificial Christmas Tree with Auto Open - Green
m05y5gzm.sourceDescription: This season isn't the same without snow. No matter the weather this year and beyond, you can bring it into your home, thanks to this HOMCOM artificial Christmas tree. It's sprayed with artificial snow and comes with no decorations bringing that wintery feel into your home, with space to dress this piece up exactly how you want it. The steel base keeps this flocked Christmas tree standing steady. The top branch is long and sturdy space for your angel or star topper. • Sprayed with faux snow for a beautiful wintery look • Tall top branch for your topper • Hinged branch design • they fall open into place • just need to be rearranged into the desired place afterwards • Undressed design: decorate exactly how you want • Steel base for tree to stand steady • Colour: Green, White • Material: PVC, Steel • Overall Dimension: 5 Ft: Φ85 x 150H cm. 6 Ft: Φ105 x 180H cm • Tip Count: 5FT: 6FT: 750 Note: Only for indoor use, not for outdoor In order to get a full appearance, please spread out all individual tips to get the best possible look from the tree, suggest you to take 25-30 minutes to shape the tree. Warning: for decoration only. Keep away from open flames, heaters and other heat sources. Ensure the product is stable before use. Keep small parts and packaging away from children. Stop using if damaged. 1 Northampton Cross Logistics Park Northampton Cross Road Northampton NN4 9FH

v6a87e3m.sourceDescription: Transform your home into a winter wonderland with this Valmorel Flocked Artificial Christmas Tree from Christow. With its naturally bushy shape and snow-covered branches, it creates a stunning festive centrepiece with minimal decorating required. This 7ft version is designed for a festive seasonal display. • Snow-Covered Winter Look: Featuring a blend of realistic pine needles and classic PVC tips, the Valmorel has a beautifully full and textured look. • Hinged Branch Construction: Designed with hinged branches for easy assembly, the tree slots together while the branches drop naturally into place. • Sturdy Green Metal Stand: Every tree includes a sturdy green metal stand with silver eyebolts for secure attachment and stable display all season long. Specifications: • Brand: Christow • Dimensions: H210cm x W111cm x D111cm • Colour: Multi Coloured • Material: PVC • Lights: Unlit • Tree shape: Full • Weight: 10.9kg For decorative use only. Not a toy. Ensure the tree is securely assembled and positioned on a stable surface. Keep away from heat and naked flames. Read and follow all instructions and safety warnings before use. Wilton Bradley Ltd, 8 Wentworth Road, Heathfield Industrial Estate, Newton Abbot, Devon, TQ12 6TL
